<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceAttendance" name="Service attendance"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Service status update by email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police app reminder" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" name="After successful service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_ServiceSuccessful" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Condition_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Service is necessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner" messageRef="Message_ServiceNotification"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" name="Await service attendance or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceAttendance" name="Service attended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_ServiceAttendance" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttendance"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_NotRegistered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Car is not registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Car is registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Attended" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttendance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttendance" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarOwner" name="Car owner actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Notification" name="Receive service notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_Notification" messageRef="Message_ServiceNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoToService" name="Go to service?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DoesNotGo" name="Does not go to service"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GoToService" name="Take car to service"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaitForUpdatesAndRepair" name="Wait for updates and repair completion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates by email" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRepairDone" name="Receive repair completion" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairReceived" name="Updates and repair completion received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_No" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="End_DoesNotGo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Does not go to service</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="Task_GoToService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Goes to service</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_GoToService" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdatesAndRepair"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForUpdatesAndRepair" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRepairDone" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_7" sourceRef="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairReceived" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_8" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_Paid"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepairDone" name="Notify car owner that repair is done" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter successful repair and that car got its Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceComplete" name="Service complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="Start_CarPresented" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Gateway_UpdatesAndRepairSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>

</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceSuccessful" name="Successful service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceNotification" name="Service notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceAttendance" name="Service attendance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CarPresented" name="Car presented for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Service status update by email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment through the app"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police app reminder" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_PoliceApp">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppSystem" name="Police app system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_AfterSuccessfulService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceAttendance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FineOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceAttended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" name="After successful service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_ServiceSuccessful" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Condition_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Service is necessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner that service is necessary" messageRef="Message_ServiceNotification"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" name="Wait for service attendance or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceAttendance" name="Service attended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_ServiceAttendance" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttendance"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_NotRegistered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Car is not registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Car is registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Attended" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttendance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttendance" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ServiceFacility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CarPresented</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRepairComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceivePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CarPresented" name="Car presented for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_CarPresented" messageRef="Message_CarPresented"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" name="Service work and status updates"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email while owner waits" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" name="Wait for repair and status updates"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairComplete" name="Send repair-complete status by email" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter successful repair and that the car got its Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceComplete" name="Service complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="Start_CarPresented" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_5" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_6" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_7" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_SendRepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_8" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_10" sourceRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_11" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarOwnerPayment" name="Car owner payment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CarOwner">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CarOwner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RepairComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PaymentMade</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_RepairComplete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentMade" name="Payment made"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="Start_RepairComplete" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_PaymentMade"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police app" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car owner" processRef="Process_CarOwnerPayment"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceSuccessful" name="Successful service" sourceRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Notification" name="Service notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner" messageRef="Message_ServiceNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Attendance" name="Service attendance" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttendance" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttendance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CarPresented" name="Car presented for service" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="Start_CarPresented" messageRef="Message_CarPresented"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Status update by email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairComplete" name="Repair complete" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairComplete" targetRef="Start_RepairComplete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment through the app" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
